task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the wger application as admin.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dashboard or navigation menu is visible, showing the 'admin' username or a logout button, indicating a successful session.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Nutrition section of the application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The URL contains '/nutrition/' or the page header/sidebar indicates the 'Nutrition' or 'Nutrition plans' section is active.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates the creation of a new nutrition plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Add nutrition plan', 'Add', or '+' button is clicked, or a form for a new nutrition plan is displayed.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the specific name 'High Protein Diet' into the plan name field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'High Protein Diet' is visible within the name input field of the nutrition plan form.

task_completion.description: Agent submits the form to save the new nutrition plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks a 'Save', 'Submit', or 'Create' button on the nutrition plan form.

task_completion.description: The nutrition plan 'High Protein Diet' is successfully created and listed.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A success message (e.g., 'Nutrition plan has been saved') appears, or 'High Protein Diet' is visible in the list of nutrition plans.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing direct database or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, typing into browser fields, and clicking web buttons rather than a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the wger fitness manager at the specified localhost address.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'localhost' and the wger UI elements are consistent throughout the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the UI rather than guessing direct POST request URLs to bypass the form.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the form fields and buttons sequentially.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The user must be logged in as 'admin'. The nutrition plan name must be exactly 'High Protein Diet'. The wger application typically lists nutrition plans under a specific 'Nutrition' menu item. Success is confirmed when the plan appears in the list or a green success banner is shown.
